items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: fellow named Chick Johnson, he was gone there so fast that he run down in the latrine

ctx.x: And he said, 'If I'd put that leg down, something would have happened.' And the other fellow, he was going there so fast, fellow named Chick Johnson, he was gone there so fast that he run down in the latrine, and he come up with all this mess on him, and he wanted to get into the barracks
and so the guys all took off their side ARMS and said, "If you come in here, we'll kill you."
